problem: BeBee needs a minimal, reproducible Defold HTML5 runtime bootstrap with an exact pinned engine/toolchain before later P0 gameplay, input, storage or visual-QA systems are implemented.

decision.rationale: Pin Defold 1.13.1 and the published Bob SHA-256, require Java 25, build wasm-web through Bob, and keep the bootstrap under the long-lived app layer. This gives an editor-independent deterministic toolchain without committing the large upstream binary or floating to latest.

research.candidate_pool_exception: Shipped-game reference research is not applicable to a technical engine/bootstrap build task.
research.reference_exception: Official Defold documentation and the published stable release artifact are authoritative for this task.

anti_pattern.observation: A floating Bob download would make the build tool version external to the repository state.
anti_pattern.lesson: Pin the upstream Bob artifact by stable release and digest rather than resolving a moving latest version.

official_docs.verified_constraint: Bob is the editor-independent build tool; current Bob requires OpenJDK 25, supports debug/release variants and wasm-web HTML5 builds.
game.project is the project configuration root; bootstrap resources use compiled resource paths and the default project input binding is a project resource unless explicitly overridden.
Input bindings are the project-wide mapping from raw device input to named actions. BB-001 supplies an empty binding resource only so no semantic input action is chosen before BB-003.
Bob supports scripted resolve/build/bundle execution suitable for an editor-independent CI path.
Defold 1.13.1 is the selected stable release; its published bob.jar digest is 8f2b1381fd4d0fb92816403cd0056cb7db5ad4083615be8dcc2d868fb4939938.

alternatives.reason: Keeps engine/tool identity reviewable and reproducible while verifying the downloaded upstream artifact cryptographically.
A moving latest version can change build behavior without a repository change and prevents historical reproduction.
Committing the large upstream binary is unnecessary when the exact release artifact can be checksum-verified and cached.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: game.project plus app/bootstrap.collection, app/bootstrap.go and app/bootstrap.script; the empty app/empty.input_binding defines no semantic actions.
